Adventure travel map: native Linux information-panel source

Image: /home/lulika/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Dwarf Fortress/dwarfort
Identity: ELF:bcc6789e6fb477b785a2b02be80b8b1b054ff88c (Steam Linux 53.16)
Complete owning procedure: VA 0x12566e0..0x1264bcd.
Native caption draw: VA 0x425170. Reference coordinates are VA-0x400000.

linux-native-decompiled.c contains Ghidra 12.1.2's C decompilation of the
complete renderer and all five helper procedures. DecompileTravelPanel.java
supplies each complete unwind body and the decoded computed-jump targets.
The C output retains Ghidra's unknown native types/global aliases; the field
names and caption grammar below are the source-derived annotations.

This is a control-flow reconstruction from that executable, not a simulated
screen. linux-renderer.asm retains the entire procedure: GCC interleaves the
structure cards, environment card, compass, odor and map glyph drawing, and
places shop caption tails as far away as VA 0x12638db. A contiguous slice
ending at VA 0x1261dc8 cannot contain all structure captions.

linux-native-switches.tsv retains all 219 entries in 11 relative jump tables.
linux-decompiled-branches.tsv records entry addresses, reachable text operands,
actual draw return addresses and dynamic suppliers. linux-native-branches.tsv
and linux-native-calls.tsv retain the procedure's other branch/call operands.
linux-panel-draw-sources.tsv records 183 structure-caption draw sites:
167 finite-caption draws, 14 abstract-name draws and 2 shrine-practice draws.
The finite-caption draws supply 72 distinct complete strings. Repeated category
fallbacks and housing captions are separate native calls, not new text variants.

Panel selection and native text geometry
---------------------------------------
The selected travel/map z coordinate selects the two structure bodies:
  z>=1: border rows 1..11; text rows 2..10; structure dispatch VA 0x125c941.
  z<1:  border rows 1..20; text rows 2..19; structure dispatch VA 0x125d958.
Caption cursor x is current native width-27 (panel_left+3).
Shop glyph cursor x is width-28 (panel_left+2). The glyph producer 0x11341e0
and its two 18-entry icon switches are independent of caption draw 0x425170.
The text column starts at the actual caption draw's x. Symbols such as '['
and '/' in the preceding column are graphics; they are not name prefixes.

Site, realization and cell selection use the same fields as the PE source
described in decompiled-text.txt: site +0x2a0 rejection flags; bounds at
+0x1f8..+0x204; z bounds +0x348/+0x34c; realization +0x308; local grid index
local_x*17+local_y; structure vector +0x17278+cell*0x40; structure type +4,
abstract building id +0x4c, info +0x58 and flags +0x78.
The realization cell flag 0x100000 at +0xb518 supplies Sewer Access before
the structure loop. The Linux draw returns are 0x125d7ca and 0x125f010.

Reconstructed structure selection
--------------------------------
Unsigned structure.type<=31 gates both main switches. The table determines
caption behavior; schema enum values outside that guard do not print here.

  type 0 cottage_plot, 4 house:
    collect housing counters (no individual caption).
  type 1 castle_wall, 2 castle_tower, 3 castle_courtyard, 6 tomb,
       10 pasture, 11 waste, 12 courtyard, 14 vault, 15 great_tower,
       27 meadow, 30 necromancer_tower:
    continue without a caption.
  type 5 temple, 19 mead_hall, 21 library, 22 tavern, 23 counting_house,
       24 guild_hall, 25 city_tower:
    if abstract_building_id==-1: use the category fallback;
    else look up id in site.buildings (+0x2b0), using helper 0x1272140;
    if lookup fails or its returned object is null: use category fallback;
    else call virtual getName at vtable+0x10;
    if name is null: use category fallback;
    else language_name formatter 0x12c58d0(name, English=true, first_person=false).
    Fallbacks: Temple, Mead Hall, Library, Tavern, Counting House, Guildhall, Tower.
  type 7 shop_house:
    draw its subtype glyph;
    if flags&1: Abandoned shop;
    else info.type in 0..17 selects the shop caption table below.
  type 8 warehouse: Warehouse.
  type 9 market_square:
    if flags&1: Empty market;
    else unsigned(info.type-18)<=6 selects the market table below.
  type 13 well: Well.
  type 16 trenches: Trenches.
  type 17 tree_house:
    info.type in 0..8 selects the tree caption table below;
    no tree_info.name is formatted by this producer.
  type 18 hillock_house:
    info.type==0: collect housing counters;
    info.type==1: Civic Mound;
    info.type==2: Castle Mound;
    info.type==3: Drinking Mound.
  type 20 fortress_entrance: Fortress Entrance.
  type 26 shrine: use the complete religious-practice production below.
  type 28 dormitory: Dormitory.
  type 29 dininghall: Dining Hall when z>=1, Dining hall when z<1.
  type 31 barrow: Barrow.

Out-of-range tree/shop/market subtypes supply no caption. Some native paths
still advance the row counter despite drawing no ink. The extraction retains
those branch targets; they must not be turned into invented labels.

Shop captions: both 18-entry tables
----------------------------------
  0 General imports                 9 Weaponsmith's shop
  1 Food imports                   10 Bowyer's shop
  2 Clothing imports               11 Blacksmith's shop
  3 Cloth shop                     12 Armorsmith's shop
  4 Leather shop                   13 Metal craft shop
  5 Woven clothing shop            14 Leather goods shop
  6 Leather clothing shop          15 Carpenter's shop
  7 Bone carver's shop             16 Stone furniture shop
  8 Gem cutter's shop              17 Metal furniture shop

These 36 caption calls, not only their icon dispatch tables, must carry the
Literal source type. All were outside the previous Linux binding inventory.
Example native return addresses:
  Woven clothing shop: 0x1261f75 / 0x12623c6.
  Weaponsmith's shop: 0x1261f98 / 0x126261d.
  Gem cutter's shop: 0x126206a / 0x1262640.
  General imports: 0x12620d3 / 0x1262712.

Market captions (native info.type 18..24)
---------------------------------------
  18 Imported goods market
  19 Imported food market
  20 Imported clothing market
  21 Meat market
  22 Fruit and vegetable market
  23 Cheese market
  24 Processed goods market

Tree captions (native info.type 0..8)
-----------------------------------
  0 Tree House; 1 The Home Tree; 2 Shaping Tree; 3 Market Tree;
  4 Tavern Tree; 5 Library Tree; 6 Counting Tree; 7 Guild Tree; 8 Tower Tree.

Underground features, z>=1 only
------------------------------
Iterate realization+0xb538+cell*0xa8. Keep feature base type==7:
  subtype 11: Underground Fortress;
  subtype 10: Underground Farms;
  subtype 8 and feature+0x54!=-1: Underground Stair;
  other subtypes / missing stair target: no caption.
Draw return VAs are 0x125bc56, 0x125bc9e and 0x125bbe1.

Housing aggregation and empty state
----------------------------------
For cottage_plot, house and hillock_house.Residence:
  if flags&0x0a: ruined++;
  else if flags&1: abandoned++;
  else: intact++.
For each group, count==0 supplies no caption, count==1 selects singular,
count>1 selects plural. Site type==3 uses hillock nouns; otherwise house nouns.
The twelve complete caption strings are:
  House; Houses; Hillock; Hillocks;
  Abandoned house; Abandoned houses; Abandoned hillock; Abandoned hillocks;
  Ruined house; Ruined houses; Ruined hillock; Ruined hillocks.
The native row cap can omit later aggregates. After all applicable producers,
row==2 draws one complete string No significant structures; it is not a
separate Boolean No plus a second caption.

Shrine production and dynamic field suppliers
--------------------------------------------
Null info supplies Shrine. Nonnull info has practice_type at +8 and id at +0xc:
  type 0 WORSHIP_HFID:
    append Shrine to ; construct context through 0xada1a0;
    append historical figure using 0xa10320 with context flags=0 and words 1,1.
  type 1 RELIGION_ENID:
    resolve historical entity; when present, append entity.name using
    0xa278f0(flags=0), formatted by 0x12c58d0(English=true, first_person=false);
    z>=1 prints {entity name} shrine; z<1 prints Shrine of {entity name}.
  other practice values / unresolved religion entity: no text operands added.
The constructed complete shrine is drawn at 0x125cb4b or 0x125de25.
The deity branches jump back to these common draws; 0x1260d3d and 0x1261047
are ordinary Temple and Ruined hillock fallbacks, not deity draw endpoints.

With the panel's fresh context and word arguments, figure helper 0xa10320 can
supply a named historical figure, an unnamed a + optional zombie/ghostly +
species/caste description, an optional generated creature name, or the complete
fallback an unknown creature. Species/caste formatter is 0x12ae800. The name
and creature vocabulary comes from language_name and RAW records, so complete
dynamic names cannot be enumerated as finite literal variants.
LPAGE markup, possessive/person/interrogator/subject modes in the general
helper are disabled by this caller's arguments. All helper instructions and
literal operands remain available in linux-figure-reference.asm,
linux-entity-name.asm, linux-english-name.asm and linux-species-name.asm.

Translation ownership
---------------------
Every finite caption uses the existing complete Travel building: {source}
dictionary key. Named structures use the established complete-name formatter;
shrines use the figure/entity grammar, retaining the source if a dynamic name
has no translation. The original icon column, native foreground and row bounds
remain separate from the translated caption. No custom squad.alias is involved.

The owning procedure also contains the existing natural-environment panel.
Its 51 biome selections are decoded in linux-decompiled-branches.tsv; its
temperature/tree/vegetation/surroundings, site names, construction, river,
mountain/volcano and role/order/creature-rumor operands and branches are retained
in the complete renderer source. Those rows keep the existing ecology and
adventure-travel-status translation paths described in
data/extracted/adventure-travel-status/decompiled-source.txt. Compass/odor and
map glyph calls in this shared procedure are not structure-name captions.
